title: The Pawn Steps Up
setup: Your bishop on b1 points straight at h7, and only your own pawn on e4 keeps the diagonal shut.
hint: Black's bishop is a dark-squared piece: it can never step onto the b1-h7 diagonal to block anything.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{e5+}} opens the b1-h7 diagonal and attacks the bishop in the same breath. The check has to be answered first, and no black piece can interpose on a light square, so after {{Kh8}} the pawn takes on f6 for free.
